resources.string: The model took too long to respond, including time spent retrying. Retries have stopped; the task is not complete.

No limit applies only to the number of steps. Each task has a 15-minute total budget, including user waits and 30 seconds reserved for a summary. Cancellation cleanup may extend this time; an exact wall-clock cutoff is not guaranteed. The work allowance is 2 million tokens using provider-reported usage, including cached tokens, or estimates when usage is missing. One model call already in progress may exceed the token allowance. This is not a billing cap.
